WITH delivery_coverage AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS deliveries,
           COUNT(DISTINCT b.match_id) AS matches_with_deliveries,
           COUNT(s.match_id) AS matched_batting_rows,
           COUNT(e.match_id) AS matched_extra_rows,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE e.match_id IS NOT NULL AND s.match_id IS NULL) AS extras_without_batting_row,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE b.bowler IS NULL) AS missing_bowler,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE b.bowler IS NOT NULL AND p.player_id IS NULL) AS unknown_bowler,
           MIN(b.innings_no) AS first_innings,
           MAX(b.innings_no) AS last_innings
    FROM main.ball_by_ball AS b
    LEFT JOIN main.batsman_scored AS s USING (match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no)
    LEFT JOIN main.extra_runs AS e USING (match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no)
    LEFT JOIN main.player AS p ON p.player_id = b.bowler
),
over_bowlers AS (
    SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, COUNT(DISTINCT bowler) AS bowlers
    FROM main.ball_by_ball
    GROUP BY match_id, innings_no, over_id
)
SELECT dc.*,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main."match") AS all_matches,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.batsman_scored) AS batting_rows,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.extra_runs) AS extra_rows,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.batsman_scored WHERE runs_scored IS NULL) AS null_batting_runs,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.extra_runs WHERE extra_runs IS NULL) AS null_extra_runs,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM over_bowlers WHERE bowlers > 1) AS shared_overs
FROM delivery_coverage AS dc

WITH all_runs AS (
    SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, runs_scored AS runs FROM main.batsman_scored
    UNION ALL
    SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, extra_runs FROM main.extra_runs
),
totals AS (
    SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, SUM(runs) AS runs
    FROM all_runs GROUP BY match_id, innings_no, over_id
),
bowling AS (
    SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, COUNT(DISTINCT bowler) AS bowler_count
    FROM main.ball_by_ball GROUP BY match_id, innings_no, over_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT t.*, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, runs) AS equal_scores,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id ORDER BY runs DESC, innings_no, over_id) AS rn
    FROM totals AS t
),
winners AS (
    SELECT r.*, b.bowler_count
    FROM ranked AS r LEFT JOIN bowling AS b USING (match_id, innings_no, over_id)
    WHERE r.rn = 1
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS scored_matches, SUM(w.runs) AS sum_of_maxima, AVG(w.runs) AS average_of_maxima,
       SUM(w.equal_scores > 1) AS matches_with_top_ties,
       SUM(w.bowler_count > 1) AS shared_winning_overs,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE w.bowler_count IS NULL) AS missing_winning_overs,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bowling AS b LEFT JOIN totals AS t USING (match_id, innings_no, over_id)
        WHERE t.match_id IS NULL) AS overs_without_scores,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM totals AS t LEFT JOIN bowling AS b USING (match_id, innings_no, over_id)
        WHERE b.match_id IS NULL) AS overs_without_deliveries,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main."match" AS m LEFT JOIN winners AS x USING (match_id)
        WHERE x.match_id IS NULL) AS catalog_matches_without_overs,
       MAX(CASE WHEN m.match_id IS NULL THEN w.match_id END) AS uncatalogued_scored_match,
       MAX(CASE WHEN m.match_id IS NULL THEN w.runs END) AS uncatalogued_match_maximum,
       MAX(CASE WHEN w.bowler_count > 1 THEN w.match_id END) AS example_shared_winner
FROM winners AS w LEFT JOIN main."match" AS m USING (match_id)

arguments.sql:
WITH scoring AS (
    SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, runs_scored AS runs
    FROM main.batsman_scored
    UNION ALL
    SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, extra_runs AS runs
    FROM main.extra_runs
),
ranked_overs AS (
    SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, SUM(runs) AS total_runs,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY match_id
               -- Select the earliest over when totals tie.
               ORDER BY SUM(runs) DESC, innings_no, over_id
           ) AS over_rank
    FROM scoring
    GROUP BY match_id, innings_no, over_id
),
winning_over_bowlers AS (
    SELECT r.match_id, r.innings_no, r.over_id, r.total_runs,
           b.bowler, MIN(b.ball_id) AS first_ball
    FROM ranked_overs AS r
    LEFT JOIN main.ball_by_ball AS b USING (match_id, innings_no, over_id)
    WHERE r.over_rank = 1
    GROUP BY r.match_id, r.innings_no, r.over_id, r.total_runs, b.bowler
)
SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, total_runs,
       GROUP_CONCAT(bowler, ', ' ORDER BY first_ball) AS bowler_ids,
       AVG(total_runs) OVER () AS avg_highest_over_runs
FROM winning_over_bowlers
GROUP BY match_id, innings_no, over_id, total_runs
ORDER BY match_id
LIMIT -1
